title: i gave you a sniper. you still owe me a knife kill.
author: Equivalent-Honey5812
selftext:
Every Gun Game kill swaps your gun. Pistol to sniper, then a KARAMBIT kill to finish.



I made STRIKEFALL by talking with Savi on Spawn. I pushed for buildings you can enter and water that splashes when shot. The design calls were mine, including what needed another pass.



Combat needed that pass. Player guns were tuned to hit about 35 percent harder, and bots got a reaction delay and started missing.



You can slide, dash and mantle across Dustline in 5v5 fights, with bots in every empty seat. I would like to hear whether the Gun Game ladder feels fair from the other side of the build.



[https://www.spawn.co/@jookie75/strikefall](https://www.spawn.co/@jookie75/strikefall)
